rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for duty, advice, desirability, and likelihood.

example.english: It ought to rain tonight, so remember to bring an umbrella.
example.traditional: 今晚應該會落雨，記得帶遮。
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 jing1 goi1 wui5 lok6 jyu5 gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1

rows.note: Use 要 when the duty sounds firm or close to an instruction rather than neutral advice.

example.english: You ought to get to work on time tomorrow; don't be late again.
example.traditional: 你聽日要準時返工，唔好再遲到。
example.jyutping: nei5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 zeon2 si4 faan1 gung1 m4 hou2 zoi3 ci4 dou3

rows.note: Use 最好 when recommending what would be the wisest or most desirable course of action.

example.english: We ought to leave early to avoid the traffic jam.
example.traditional: 我哋最好早啲出門口，避開塞車。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zeoi3 hou2 zou2 di1 ceot1 mun4 hau2 bei6 hoi1 sak1 ce1
